name: Jordan Stilwell
summary: Outside Ironforge’s gates in Dun Morogh, Jordan Stilwell works at his forge. He was meant for the Church of the Holy Light, but followed his father into smithing and learned from Bailor Stonehand. His craft serves paladins across the Alliance, and he forged Verigan’s Fist in honor of his old friend, Bosch Verigan.

sections.title: A Calling at the Anvil
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell was expected to take holy vows and become a paladin in the Church of the Holy Light. Instead, he followed his father’s path as a smith and took up his father’s enchanted hammer. The dwarven blacksmith Bailor Stonehand helped him refine his craft. Jordan remains deeply faithful to the Light, and puts his skill to work outfitting champions who fight in its name.

sections.title: Flight from Silverpine
sections.body: Jordan once worked as a smith at the keep of Baron Silverlaine in Silverpine Forest. When Archmage Arugal unleashed feral worgen upon the fortress and turned it into Shadowfang Keep, Jordan escaped the bloodshed. He left his forge and former home behind, and eventually found refuge among the dwarves of Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Forging Verigan's Fist
sections.body: Jordan keeps his forge outdoors near the gates of Ironforge, where he favors the alpine air over the heat of the Great Forge inside the mountain. The Church of the Holy Light sends worthy paladins to him, and he sets them to recovering rare materials from across the world for a legendary two-handed warhammer. Jordan named the weapon Verigan’s Fist in honor of his old friend, Bosch Verigan. Its steel joins faith with masterful craft.

aliases: who is this blacksmith outside ironforge
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell works as a human blacksmith outside the Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh. He crafts sacred arms for paladins of the Church of the Holy Light, including Verigan’s Fist.

faq.q: Why does Jordan Stilwell work outside in the snow instead of inside Ironforge?
aliases: why is he in the snow
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall in Stormwind says Jordan prefers Dun Morogh’s crisp mountain air to the stifling Great Forge inside Ironforge.

faq.q: What is Jordan Stilwell's connection to Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: Jordan once served as an armorer and blacksmith at Baron Silverlaine’s estate in Silverpine Forest. He escaped the keep before or during the uprising, when Archmage Arugal and his feral worgen slaughtered the garrison and took the fortress.
Verigan’s Fist is a powerful two-handed holy hammer Jordan Stilwell forged for Alliance paladins. He named it in honor of his old friend, Bosch Verigan.

faq.q: Who trained Jordan Stilwell in blacksmithing?
faq.answer: Jordan inherited his smithing craft and an enchanted hammer from his father. He refined his skill under Bailor Stonehand, a dwarven blacksmith.
Jordan is married to Daphne Stilwell. Together, they have aided the Church of the Holy Light greatly over the years, and both are revered as deeply devout servants of the faith.

angles.text: As a paladin, you may be sent by Jordan Stilwell to seek rare materials across Azeroth for Verigan’s Fist, your signature warhammer.
Jordan learned from Bailor Stonehand and wields an enchanted hammer inherited from his father. His work is among the finest holy smithing practiced by mortals.
After fleeing Arugal’s worgen in Silverpine Forest, Jordan found refuge among the dwarves of Dun Morogh. He now lends his craft to Alliance champions.
